# Kiddle Kids Encyclopedia

> > A kid-friendly encyclopedia providing accessible facts about world topics including British culture, mathematics, entertainment, and notable people.

Kiddle Kids Encyclopedia offers educational content tailored for children, covering diverse subjects from cultural institutions like the British Council to mathematical concepts, television entertainment, and biographies of artists and poets from around the world.

## Key Topics

- United Kingdom
- British Council
- Cultural institutions
- English language teaching
- International education
- Biography
- Moscow
- London
- Eurovision
- Russian culture
- Mathematics
- Pop culture
- National symbols
- Arts and culture
- Educational programs

## British Culture and Institutions

- [List of British national symbols Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/List_of_British_national_symbols): National symbols of UK, England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
- [British Council Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/British_Council): UK cultural institution for English teaching and international education

## Notable People and Biographies

- [Polina Gagarina Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Polina_Gagarina): Russian singer and Eurovision contestant biography
- [Sergei Yesenin Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Sergei_Yesenin): Russian lyrical poet known for peasant and nature poetry

## Entertainment and Pop Culture

- [Los Pollos Hermanos Facts for Kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Los_Pollos_Hermanos): Fictional restaurant from Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul TV shows
